messages.subject: Falcon - internal: where we are on the cap
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah, Elena,

Quick internal note. Birchall Stone have conceded the 18-month non-compete. I think we land the founder cap at £3.5m in exchange for tightening de minimis/basket to £35k/£350k and dropping general survival to 2 years - all of which the client is comfortable with. Westbridge still want MFN in the side letter, which is fine. Elena, can you turn the v3 redline tomorrow?

James

Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
